description: Java class EcuDefinitionHandler extends DefaultHandler to parse XML files defining ECU (Engine Control Unit) configurations, extracting details like IDs, year, make, model, transmission, and other ECU attributes, and storing them in a map for further use.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionHandler
classes.description: A SAX parser handler for reading ECU definition XML files and constructing a map of ECU definitions.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes the ECU definition map at the start of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, initializing variables when a new 'romid' element begins, and capturing attributes for 'rom' elements.

methods.name: characters
methods.description: Appends character data between XML tags to a buffer.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Processes the end of XML elements, extracting data from the buffer, constructing ECU definitions, and logging details.

methods.name: getEcuDefinitionMap
methods.description: Returns the map of ECU definitions parsed from the XML.

methods.name: romDetail
methods.description: Generates a string with detailed information about the current ECU definition being parsed.
